# Sama Eldesouki

> Full stack and AI developer. First Class BSc Computer Science, University of Birmingham (2026). Builds accessible tools, from fine-tuned language models to the interface, and also designs and builds websites, brand identities, motion graphics and copy for small businesses in the UK.

Open to graduate roles in software, AI and anything that puts tech in front of people. Contact: s.ayrzpersonal@gmail.com. Based in the UK.

## Pages

- [Portfolio home](https://sayrz1.github.io/): projects, about, skills, experience and contact
- [Websites for small shops](https://sayrz1.github.io/websites/): concept sites for a takeaway, a bakery and a slush bar; free demo first, from £300
- [Graphic design](https://sayrz1.github.io/design/): 11 concept brand identities with logo, palette, packaging and social posts in English and Arabic
- [Motion](https://sayrz1.github.io/motion/): motion graphics, ads for small shops and two short-film series, written, voiced, animated and scored by Sama
- [Copywriting](https://sayrz1.github.io/copy/): ads, captions, web pages and scripts, shown as before-and-after rewrites

## Projects

- [Lunar Navigator](https://sayrz1.github.io/lunar-navigator): NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 team project. A web app for choosing where and when to land on the Moon, using real NASA LOLA terrain horizons and Sun/Earth positions checked against NASA JPL Horizons. JavaScript, Three.js, Web Workers, Python, NumPy. Earned the Galactic Problem Solver certificate.
- LexiLift: final year NLP project. A Chrome extension that rewrites web pages into simpler English at a chosen CEFR level (A2, B1, B2), served by a local FastAPI backend so nothing leaves the machine. Six fine-tuned T5-small and BART-base models; the deployed T5 model scores 56.43 SARI. Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, ONNX.
- RelAI: HCI team project. A dashboard that helps people keep their AI tool use in check, with a daily limit dial, streaks and reflection prompts. React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase.
- [Ember & Spit](https://sayrz1.github.io/ember-and-spit): concept site for a late-night shawarma shop in Birmingham, with a scroll animation, menu with prices and allergens, and collection or delivery times. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GSAP.
- [Crumbwell](https://sayrz1.github.io/crumbwell): concept site for an East London bakery with a live bake board, UK and US editions and order ahead. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GSAP, Lenis.
- [Brrr.](https://sayrz1.github.io/brrr): concept site for a Manchester slush bar built around a 3D cup that changes flavour as you scroll. Three.js, GSAP.
- Campus Connect: team full stack app for university events and profiles. JHipster, Angular, TypeScript, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS.
- Evolutionary computation: a population-based evolutionary algorithm for MAXSAT, tuned on MAXSAT Evaluation 2017 benchmarks, and a comparison of simulated annealing and genetic algorithms on airline crew scheduling. Python, Docker.
- Teaching code: Year 10 Pygame lessons where students fix a deliberately broken game (a maze with 13 planted bugs, Pong with 6) to learn debugging.
- Also built: an inventory management system (Java, JavaFX, PostgreSQL) and a news classifier using GloVe word embeddings (Java).
